reviews.title: Amazing & Budget Friendly!
reviews.comment:
I purchased the style Air 100 mATX case.
This case comes with 4 pre installed fans (ARGB). The lights can be connected to the motherboard or a button on the top of the case. Because of the way the wiring was set up I decided to connect the lights to the case's provided led button. It has many options and works just fine for my needs. The fans are quiet and strong! They provide substantial airflow throughout. The case comes with a swivel door that allows easy access- very convenient and attractive appearance for any build in my opinion. The dust cover designed for the top of the case does catch a significant amount of dust when used. You will want to remove the back panel occasionally to remove dust build up where your cable management is, though. Overall you really can't beat the quality for the price of this case. I've been using it for well over a year now (at the time of writing this review) and have no complaints whatsoever. If you're looking for a budget friendly but high quality option- this is your case!
reviews.author: Sarah Elizabeth

reviews.title: 3rd Montech case, 3rd time I’ve been impressed
reviews.comment:
I have both the Montech XR and the mesh rgb case and I love both of them. I build and sell budget friendly starter pcs in my spare time, usually matx, so when I saw they had this case I was intrigued.
First: the build quality. It feels exceptionally sturdy for its size. It doesn’t have that “cheap metal” type of feel a lot of other matx cases have. It feels very well built. The features on this case are extraordinary as well. The magnetic front mesh panel is a godsend. Cleaning out the fans will be a breeze for whoever gets this. The glass door and easily accessible door handle are a nice feature. The fans that came with are decent quality as well - although they are somewhat on the “noisy” side. Definitely not a dealbreaker at all, the cooler the better in my opinion. But overall, the quality is better than I expected but having two other Montech cases, it came as no surprise.
Second: building in the case. It was EXTREMELY easy to build in this. I’ve built in plenty of matx cases and this one by far was the easiest I’ve built in. The cable management was practically done for me before even beginning the build. I altered some things around but otherwise I left the cables where they were. Take a look at the pictures for reference. If this is your first build, you will be pleasantly surprised by the ease of cable management with this case.
Final thoughts: This is one heck of a deal for an matx case. I was not expecting a perfect case, but I believe I may have found it. Simple, easy to build in, efficient, and excellent build quality. Get yourself one if you haven’t already or are on the fence on it. You will not regret it.
reviews.author: Isaac

reviews.title: Air 100
reviews.comment: Price, performance, style. This case is awesome. The included fans work great for air cooling. (The have a cool pattern of holes on the sides of the housing making them not good for radiators) Easy to build in. No sharp edges. Powdercoat seems very durable. The value is insane.
reviews.author: Octavio L. de la Mora

reviews.title: Better that I expected!
reviews.comment:
I bought tis for my teenage son as replacement for an older case. He has hard many hard to diagnose issues and I have replaced most every component in the system except the case.  I finally saw him playing a game for hours when the system crashed. At the time all of the fans were very loud but not keeping up to the heat.
I bought this case mostly for the price and the fans. I was really prepared to not like the case since most info said the fans were RGB and not pwm controlled. They turned out to be ARGB with a controller but are not PWM.
I was surprised while installing components that  I was starting to like the case. It has decent cable management with velcro straps , plenty of zip ties and a good selection of screws including fan screws. They came in handy for the two 140mm top exhaust fans I added.
When done I had him run some demanding games and so far it is running without issue. Far quieter and cooler.
This is a good case for a teenager , it went together well has good cooling without being too loud and did not break the bank.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Perfect case for my first PC build
reviews.comment:
This case was a perfect fit for the following:
- Asus B550 Prime A-AC
- Ryzen 7 5800XT + Stock Cooler
- Gigabyte RX 7600 (3 fans)
- Corsair 650 PSU (semi-modular)
I use the case button to control the RGB.
My only small complaints were that the included screws and accessories were fairly random, and the top USB inputs feel flimsy compared to the MOBO inputs.
Still recommend this case!
reviews.author: Phil
